other_conditions: Households with no adult member aged 16‑59
Female‑headed households with no adult male aged 16‑59
Households with no literate adult above 25 years
Households with any disabled member and no able‑bodied adult member
Landless households whose major income is from manual casual labour

Tie‑breaker criteria such as households with widows or next‑of‑kin of defence personnel killed in action, households with members suffering from leprosy, cancer or HIV, households with a single girl child, beneficiaries of the Forest Rights Act, and transgender persons
benefits_summary: Financial assistance up to ₹1.20  lakh per house (₹1.30  lakh in hilly/difficult areas), with optional loan up to ₹70 000 at reduced interest, plus subsidies for toilets, LPG connection, employment under MGNREGA, and other convergent services.
